pages.text: From $(l)Rat Season$() on, the Pestilence builds itself homes near wherever people are, never close to where they sleep. You will hear one form: scratching, a smell, the ground opening.$(br2)A nest grows from stage $(l)I$() to $(l)IV$() over the days, getting harder to break each time, and it feeds the Pestilence every day it stands. A stage IV nest $(4)plants new ones$().

pages.title: Rat Warren
pages.text: A burrowed mound that keeps breeding rats. Breaking it lets out whatever was still inside, so come ready. Each stage adds a burrow hole.

pages.title: Plague Pit
pages.text: Opens from $(l)Heralds$() on, or wherever three corpses have risen close together. It turns up bodies that will rise if left. It is almost too hard to dig; $(l)quicklime$() fills it in, one stage per handful.

pages.title: Miasma Well
pages.text: From the $(l)Black Death$() on. A stone ring full of green sludge that breathes miasma clouds and spreads the Blight fastest of all. Go masked.
